loading — MatchCardSkeleton

The set in play is emphasised with bg-muted — not a surface step. The surface ramp collapses to white in light mode, so a level-3 chip on a level-1 card would be invisible there; the emphasis has to come from a token that differs from the card in both modes. That is rule 3 doing real work.

Only a finished match has a losing side to play down. A live one is still anyone's, so neither line is dimmed while it is being played.
